instruction: A hovering hummingbird assembled from leaded stained-glass panes, its wings and tail split into jewel-toned emerald, sapphire, and ruby segments outlined by dark solder lines. Backlight glows through the translucent glass, casting colored light and giving the long needle beak a luminous tip.
